latestVersion.changelog:
Sora AI Video Maker skill initial release:

- Generate high-quality 1080p MP4 videos from text prompts via cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports uploading media files (mp4, mov, webm, gif, jpg, png, mp3, etc.) up to 500MB per file.
- Anonymous users receive free credits for AI video generation after simple token registration.
- Provides workflows for uploading, editing, previewing, exporting, and checking credits/status.
- Designed for concise, prompt-driven AI video creation; typical render time 1–3 minutes per clip.
- Robust error handling and guided interactions help users handle authentication, credits, and export issues smoothly.
